title: Require Generic Service Anchor Exports
forbids: a service spine file without its direct generic anchor and required native portable type, a public implementation anchor other than configured service, a module wiring file with a second export, or a context file with runtime authority
why: Generic local anchors keep contract authoring, context, implementation, module descent, and router composition visible without product-qualified aliases or compatibility exports. One canonical Service alias over EffectImplementerInternal plus ServiceModule and EnhancedEffectRouter<Modules, ...> annotations keep large service declarations portable while preserving direct branch access and runtime lineage. The pinned Effect-oRPC implementation stage remains private; only its configured service stage is exported.
remediate: Export base, Context, contract, the canonical Service-typed configured service, ServiceModule<K> = Service[K], each typed ServiceModule module branch, and the exact EnhancedEffectRouter<Modules, Context, Context, Record<never, never>> root from their owning spine files. Keep impl private in impl.ts, remove alternate runtime exports and forwarding exports from spine files, and keep module.ts limited to the module value.
message: Each service spine file must expose only its generic local authority.
